accountStoreConclusions.dominantWait: account_store.store_wait measures exactly account_store.lock(), separate from frozen/write-state WritableWait
accountStoreConclusions.interpretation: Many concurrent thresholded waits dominate. No >=50ms completed frozen-state wait is captured. A lack of logged holder does not mean no holder: each holder may be <50ms, may be uninstrumented, or may not have completed. The lone transaction StoreHeld and MarkerBeginSync are nested.

sourceMap.meaning: ExperienceAdmission record; StoreWait only AccountStore mutex acquisition, StoreHeld includes second frozen check and whole admission callback.
GuildLookup StoreWait only AccountStore mutex acquisition; StoreHeld scans membership and clones owner guild record.
Personal refresh first calls refresh_shared_experience_profiles, then AccountStore admission callback takes Zone lock and rebases all registered recipients.
Shared refresh always refreshes own trusted profile; generation miss iterates peer authority lookups and guild projection.
Predrain includes pet/personal experience refresh, pending packet drain, kill/mentor reconciliation and shared target snapshots.
inner_execute includes pet refresh, action branch and personal runtime, so not pure session.inner.execute CPU.
pending_lock_wait measures one pending-drain Zone mutex acquisition only; not all Zone locks.
Socket input holds serial write guard across command and flush.
Outbox takes serial read guard before its batch; blocked first packet prevents remaining batch pop.
Flush includes responses, external refresh, optional snapshot, save and route refresh; allowed public rows do not uniquely locate the 1032ms within these.
GatewaySlowStage emits synchronously to stderr in Drop; this audit cannot separate emission/scheduling overhead from broad spans.

boundedOptimizationAssessment.supportedTarget: Repeated AccountStore authority acquisition / full-recipient experience rebase inside ordinary private command predrain, plus input write-gate residency across flush.
boundedOptimizationAssessment.firstCandidate: Audit redundant personal/peer profile refresh calls within one command, and reuse one immutable parsed authority view under the existing exact frozen checks/publication lock ordering; retain trusted owner-rate refresh and linearize death/reward admission with the authoritative store.
